research_scope: Time Skip/Flash Skewer — Strike Super / Counter Skill.

duplicate_check.repository_history_search: No prior research commit found for this skill.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Xenoverse 2 reference classifies Flash Skewer as a Strike Super and Counter Skill. Canonical identity is Super / Strike.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Training with Hit; Dragon Ball Wiki identifies the Future Warrior as learning it through Hit's initiation test. Associated with Super Pack 2.
verification_audit.availability_finding: The Future Warrior can learn the skill; usable_by_cac true.
verification_audit.finish_policy: Instructor-training acquisition, not a PQ reward; ultimate_finish_required false.
verification_audit.mechanics_finding: The user enters a defensive stance and, when struck from the front by a Strike attack, counterattacks. The current Xenoverse 2 reference lists it as short-range, single-hit and unblockable, with approximately 5% initial damage and follow-up opportunities.

records.name: Time Skip/Flash Skewer
records.ultimate_finish_evidence: Documented acquisition is instructor training rather than a Parallel Quest reward.
records.skill_description: Time skip and attack an opponent in front of you.
records.mechanics_notes: A defensive stance counters a front-side Strike hit. The current skill reference describes a short-range, single-hit, unblockable counter and lists approximately 5% initial damage, with follow-up attacks possible.
records.acquisition_notes: Dragon Ball Wiki states that the Future Warrior learns the technique through Hit's initiation test.
records.pve_notes: Exact AI behavior and current quest-specific interactions are not independently verified.
records.pvp_notes: Historical community reports indicate balance changes to Flash Skewer; current frame data is not recorded here.
